4. The present petitioner was not made a party in that suit who filed Title Suit No. 77 of 2002 on 3-8-2002 for setting aside the preliminary decree, and final decree passed in Title Suit No. 4 of 1987 and also for a permanent injunction restraining the present opposite party No. 1 from disturbing the plaintiff's peaceful possession in 0.01-1/4 acre of land appertaining to Plot No. 683 under Khatian No. 297 of mouza Sultanpur Uttar under Police Station Madhabpur, District Habiganj till disposal of the suit. The present petitioner made an application on 3-8-2002 for restraining the opposite-party No. 1 by way of temporary injunction from dispossessing the petitioner from his homestead constructed upon the suit land and from disturbing his peaceful possession in the said homestead and from causing any damage to the said homestead. The learned Assistant judge by order dated 29-1-2004 allowed the prayer for injunction on contest and restrained the present opposite-party as prayed for. 

 14. In the result, the Rule issued in Civil Revision No. 1330 of 2004 is made absolute without any order as to costs. The order dated 25-2-2004 passed by the learned District Judge, Habiganj in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 8 of 2004 is set aside. The leaned District Judge is directed to hear and dispose of the appeal as early as possible preferably within 3(three) months from the date or receipt of this order. The Rule issued in Civil Rule No. 368(R) of 2004 is also made absolute. The learned Assistant Judge, Madhabpur is directed to restore possession in 0.033 acre of land of Plot No. 683, khatian No. 279, Mouza Sultanpur, Police Station Madhabpur, District Habiganj, in favour of the petitioner within 7(seven) days from the date of receipt of this order. The learned Assistant Judge is also directed to dispose of the suit as early as possible preferably within 1(one) year from the date of receipt of this order.
